purpose: Second-scale target-certified replication of a non-clipped source-derived slack candidate

exclude: the 500 prior P10 IDs reconstructed with RandomState(991)
the 1000 prior Deep1M scale-check IDs frozen with default_rng(2991)
query_firewall.rule: draw 1500 IDs without replacement from remaining test IDs, sort within each consecutive 500-ID role, and freeze IDs and hashes before vector, truth, or search access

action_policy.source_action: per source build, smallest grid action whose one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson UCB on source_design is at most 0.05; if none, endpoint
action_policy.candidate: one registered rung above the source action, clipped only at 1200
action_policy.target_decision: on target_certification, deploy candidate if its one-sided CP UCB at alpha 0.025 is at most 0.05 and the endpoint UCB is at most 0.05; otherwise use certified endpoint; abstain if endpoint fails
action_policy.evaluation_blinding: target_evaluation cannot alter source action, candidate, threshold, grid, or fallback

reports: candidate clipping rate and deployment/fallback/abstention counts
relative mean NDC saving versus efSearch=1200

gates.protocol: all three roles disjoint from one another and prior roles; no evaluation access before freeze
gates.safety: candidate or endpoint decision has target CP UCB at most 0.05; evaluation risk reported without changing decisions
gates.non_clipped_evidence: at least one source-derived candidate is below endpoint
gates.efficiency: crossed 95% lower bound for relative mean NDC saving is above zero
gates.tail: pooled p95 ratio at most one and no structural worst-target degradation

stop_rules: stop on query-role overlap, dataset/index hash drift, incomplete exact truth, counter mismatch, or endpoint certification failure
stop if data500 free space is below projected additions plus 5 GiB
do not modify the grid, role IDs, policy, threshold, or estimand after the first new role vector, truth, or search access
do not claim cross-implementation confirmation from this hnswlib scale replication
